en: It is the first day of junior high school.
zh: 今天是初中的第一天。

en: In the morning, Lily meets her new classmate Tom at the school gate.
zh: 早上，Lily在校门口遇到了她的新同学Tom。

en: "Hello!" Tom answers with a big smile.
zh: “你好！”汤姆面带灿烂的笑容回答。

en: "How are you?" "I'm fine, thank you.
zh: 这是块做工精细的表。

en: Tom arrived at school and found his schoolbag was messy.
zh: 汤姆来到学校，发现他的书包乱七八糟的。

en: He looked inside and saw many things.
zh: 他往里看了一眼，看到很多东西。

en: 'What do I have in my schoolbag?' he thought.
zh: “我的书包里有什么？”他想。

en: Tom was looking for his keys because he needed to open his locker.
zh: 汤姆在找他的钥匙，因为他需要打开他的储物柜。

en: Suddenly, he found them next to the eraser.
zh: 突然，他在橡皮擦旁边找到了它们。

en: Last Sunday morning, Tom visited his uncle's farm.
zh: 上周日早上，汤姆去了他叔叔的农场。

en: In the yard, he saw many animals.
zh: 在院子里，他看到了许多动物。

en: 'What are those?' Tom asked.
zh: “那些是什么？”汤姆问道。

en: After that, his uncle gave him a carrot.
zh: 之后，他的叔叔给了他一根胡萝卜。

en: 'Look at this carrot,' said his uncle.
zh: “看看这根胡萝卜，”叔叔说。

en: 'It's fresh and good for you.' Tom thought it would be fun to feed the animals.
zh: “这是新鲜的，对你有好处。”“汤姆觉得喂动物很有趣。”

en: On the first day of school, I met my new classmate Tom.
zh: 开学第一天，我认识了我的新同学汤姆。

en: We are in the same class, Class 1, Grade 7.
zh: 我们是同班同学，七年级一班。

en: She asked us to get to know each other.
zh: 她让我们互相认识一下。

en: Tom comes from a small country.
zh: 汤姆来自一个很小的国家。

en: Teng Fei is a 14-year-old boy who loves spending time with his family.
zh: 腾飞是一个14岁的男孩，喜欢和家人一起度过时光。

en: Every Sunday, he plays ping-pong with his grandpa at the sports hall.
zh: 每个星期日，他都在体育馆和爷爷打乒乓球。

en: His grandpa is very handsome and really enjoys sports.
zh: 他的爷爷非常英俊，非常喜欢运动。

en: They have two nice ping-pong bats and always have fun together.
zh: 他们有两副漂亮的乒乓球拍，总是玩得很开心。

en: Teng Fei's father is different from his grandpa - he prefers reading books.
zh: 腾飞的父亲和爷爷不同——他更喜欢读书。

en: He spends a lot of time in the study every day.
zh: 他每天花很多时间在书房里。

en: Where is the library?
zh: 图书馆在哪里？

en: Where are the bookcases?
zh: 书柜在哪里？

en: It is behind the classroom building.
zh: 它在教学楼后面。

en: They are next to the window.
zh: 它们在窗户旁边。

en: Is there a whiteboard in your classroom?
zh: 您的教室里有白板吗？

en: Are there any lockers?
zh: 有储物柜吗？

en: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
zh: 是的，有。/不，没有。

en: Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
zh: 是的，有。/不，没有。

en: There is a teachers' building across from the school hall.
zh: 学校大厅对面有一栋教师楼。

en: My name is Lily, and I'm in Grade 7.
zh: 我叫莉莉，在七年级。

en: This term, my favourite subject is biology.
zh: 这学期，我最喜欢的科目是生物学。

en: I find it exciting because it helps me understand life and how things work.
zh: 我觉得它令人激动，因为它帮助我理解生命和事物如何运作。

en: In class, we learn about plants, animals, and even the human body.
zh: 在课堂上，我们学习植物、动物，甚至人体。

en: I'm good at remembering scientific facts, and I want to be a scientist in the future.
zh: 我擅长记住科学事实，将来想成为一名科学家。

en: My teacher is excellent at explaining difficult ideas.
zh: 我的老师很擅长解释复杂的概念。

en: She often uses experiments to make learning more interesting.
zh: 她经常用实验让学习更有趣。

en: Both geography and history are useful too, but biology is the most exciting for me.
zh: 地理和历史也很有用，但生物学对我来说是最令人兴奋的。

en: This term, I have subjects like Chinese, history, maths, English, PE, and IT.
zh: 本学期，我学习的科目有语文、历史、数学、英语、体育和信息技术。

en: Last week, our school held a club fair.
zh: 上周，我们学校举办了俱乐部招新活动。

en: I was interested in joining a club but couldn't decide which one.
zh: 我想要参加一个俱乐部，但决定不了选择哪一个。

en: There were many options: drama club, music club, and nature club.
zh: 有很多选项：戏剧俱乐部、音乐俱乐部和自然俱乐部。

en: In the drama club, students act out stories and plays.
zh: 在戏剧俱乐部里，学生们表演故事和戏剧。

en: I can act well, but I'm not interested in memorizing lines.
zh: 我擅长表演，但对记台词不感兴趣。

en: The music club has different musical instruments like violin and drums.
zh: 音乐俱乐部有各种乐器，如小提琴和鼓。

en: My name is Li Ming, and I'm a student from Finland.
zh: 我叫李明，是一名来自芬兰的学生。
unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life

en: My daily routine usually starts at 6:30 a.m.
zh: 我的日常作息通常从早上6:30开始。
unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life

en: I brush my teeth and take a shower before having breakfast.
zh: 我先刷牙洗澡，然后再吃早餐。
unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life

en: After that, I prepare my school bag and go to school.
zh: 之后，我收拾书包，去上学。
unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life

en: Last Saturday was my best friend Lily's birthday.
zh: 上周六是我最好的朋友莉莉的生日。

en: They told me her birthday was on 2nd August, and she would be turning thirteen.
zh: 他们告诉我她的生日是8月2日，她将满13岁。

en: I decided to organize a small celebration at her home.
zh: 我决定在她家组织一个小型庆祝活动。

en: I bought a chocolate cake, some colorful balloons, and her favorite pizza.
zh: 我买了一个巧克力蛋糕、一些彩色气球和她最喜欢的披萨。

en: She was so surprised and happy!
zh: 她非常惊讶和开心！

en: Last Sunday, I visited the zoo with my family.
zh: 上周日，我和家人一起参观了动物园。

en: I was excited to see many animals there.
zh: 我很兴奋看到那里的许多动物。

en: My favorite animal was the giraffe because it has a very long neck.
zh: 我最喜欢的动物是长颈鹿，因为它有非常长的脖子。

en: However, I felt quite sad when I learned that some animals are in danger.
zh: 然而，当我了解到一些动物处于危险中时，我感到相当难过。

en: I think we should all take care of these beautiful creatures.
zh: 我认为我们应该照顾这些美丽的生物。

en: They are our friends and we need to save them from danger.
zh: 它们是我们的朋友，我们需要将它们从危险中拯救出来。

en: No, we can’t.
zh: 不，我们不能。

en: We must keep them in our lockers.
zh: 我们必须把它们放在储物柜里。

en: No, we can’t eat in class.
zh: 不，我们不能在课堂上吃东西。

en: We have to eat in the dining hall.
zh: 我们必须在餐厅用餐。

en: Tom was late for school yesterday because he didn't follow the rules.
zh: 汤姆昨天上学迟到了，因为他没有遵守规则。

en: The teacher reminded them, 'Walk in the hallway.
zh: 老师提醒他们：“在走廊上走。”

en: Yes, that's mine.
zh: 是的，那是我的。

en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

en: I think it's Han Lin's.
zh: 我想是韩林的。

en: His has "HL" on it.
zh: 他的上面有“HL”字样。

en: I play it twice a week, usually at weekends.
zh: 我一周打两次，通常是在周末。

en: I seldom / hardly ever play it.
zh: 我很少/几乎不玩。

en: I usually have some bread and milk.
zh: 我通常会吃点面包，喝点牛奶。

en: Sometimes I have eggs and beans.
zh: 有时我会吃鸡蛋和豆子。

en: No, thanks.
zh: 不，谢谢。

en: I'd like a cup of tea.
zh: 我想要一杯茶。

en: Li Hua is a middle school student who loves eating fast food.
zh: 李华是一名中学生，他喜欢吃快餐。

en: After all, it's convenient and tasty.
zh: 毕竟，快餐既方便又美味。

en: Among his favorite meals are hamburgers and fish and chips.
zh: 他最喜欢的食物包括汉堡包和炸鱼薯条。

en: However, his mother is worried because Li Hua is getting a bit fat.
zh: 然而，他的妈妈很担心，因为李华有点胖了。

en: No.
zh: 不。

en: He's shopping at the supermarket.
zh: 他在超市购物。

en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

en: We're watching the races on TV too.
zh: 我们也在电视上看比赛。

en: It's really cold!
zh: 真冷啊！

en: What's your family doing?
zh: 您的家人在做什么？

en: Last weekend, Tom and his family went hiking in the mountains.
zh: 上周末，汤姆和他的家人去山里远足。

en: At the start, the weather was perfect with blue skies and sunshine.
zh: 开始时天气完美，天空湛蓝阳光明媚。

en: Yes, I did.
zh: 是的，我做了。

en: There was a space exhibition.
zh: 那里正在举办一场太空展览。

en: There were robots.
zh: 那里有机器人。

en: No, he didn't.
zh: 不，他没有。

en: Yes, I did.
zh: 是的，我做了。

en: It is a great book. / No, I didn't.
zh: 这是一本很棒的书。/ 不，我没有。

en: We chose a different book.
zh: 我们选了一本不同的书。

en: Yes, I do.
zh: 是的。

en: It's a funny story! / No, I don't.
zh: 这是一个有趣的故事！/ 不，我不知道。

en: Please tell me about it.
zh: 请告诉我这件事。

en: No, nothing special.
zh: 不，没什么特别的。

en: But I met someone interesting.
zh: 但我遇到一个很有趣的人。

en: Yes, we did!
zh: 是的，我们做到了！

en: Everything tasted good, especially the steamed chicken soup.
zh: 所有菜品都很好吃，尤其是炖鸡汤。

en: OK, Mum.
zh: 好的，妈妈。

en: I'll do it at once.
zh: 我马上做。

en: Last weekend, my family moved to a new apartment in our community.
zh: 上周末，我的家人搬到了我们社区的一套新公寓。

en: It was a long journey from our old home, but we felt joy when we arrived.
zh: 从我们的旧家出发，这是一段漫长的旅程，但抵达时我们感到喜悦。

en: 'Could you please help me hang up these pictures?' I asked my mum.
zh: “你能帮我把这些画挂起来吗？”我问妈妈。

en: We spent the afternoon packing up my things and arranging furniture.
zh: 我们花了一个下午的时间收拾我的东西，摆放家具。

en: Last Monday, I met a new student named Tom at school.
zh: 上周一，我在学校认识了一个名叫汤姆的新同学。

en: We were alone in the classroom when he accidentally knocked over my books.
zh: 当我们独自在教室时，他不小心撞倒了我的书。

en: I was a bit angry at first, but then I noticed his honest expression.
zh: 起初我有点生气，但我注意到了他坦诚的表情。

en: Last Sunday, I visited the nature museum with my classmates.
zh: 上周日，我和同学们参观了自然博物馆。

en: It was amazing to see so many plants and animals there.
zh: 那里有如此多的动植物，真是太神奇了。

en: In the plant section, bamboo appeared to be very useful.
zh: 在植物展区，竹子似乎非常有用。

en: For this reason, I think bamboo is perhaps the most useful plant in the world.
zh: 因此，我认为竹子或许是世界上最有用的植物。

en: I learned that bees help with pollination by carrying pollen from one flower to another.
zh: 我了解到蜜蜂通过将花粉从一朵花传到另一朵花来帮助授粉。

en: It was a wonderful day that made me understand the importance of nature.
zh: 这是美好的一天，让我理解了自然的重要性。

en: Ginkgo trees first appeared over 200 million years ago.
zh: 银杏树最早出现在2亿多年前。

en: Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet.
zh: 蜜蜂在我们星球的生态系统中扮演着重要角色。

en: Last Christmas, I decided to bake a special cake for my family.
zh: 去年圣诞节，我决定为家人烤一个特别的蛋糕。

en: I mixed these ingredients in a big bowl.
zh: 我把这些食材在一个大碗里混合。

en: At least two hours passed before I finished preparing the mixture.
zh: 至少过了两个小时我才完成混合物的准备。

en: What an amazing smell filled the kitchen!
zh: 多么美妙的味道充满了厨房！

en: When I took the cake out, I cut it into pieces.
zh: 当我把蛋糕拿出来时，我把它切成小块。

en: One by one, my family tried it and said it was delicious.
zh: 我的家人一个接一个地品尝，都说很美味。

en: This memory makes me happy because baking brings us together.
zh: 这个回忆让我很开心，因为烘焙让我们聚在一起。

en: Finally, put the eggs back into the pan and mix them with the tomatoes.
zh: 最后，将鸡蛋放回锅中，与番茄拌匀。

en: Tom is a fifteen-year-old student who is always energetic and organized.
zh: 汤姆是一名15岁的学生，他总是精力充沛、井井有条。

en: He has been thinking about his future career recently.
zh: 他最近一直在思考自己的未来职业。

en: Last week, he attended a career talk at school where different professionals introduced their jobs.
zh: 上周，他参加了学校的职业讲座，多位专业人士在讲座上介绍了自己的工作。

en: Tom found out that he wants to be an engineer like his father.
zh: 汤姆发现自己想像父亲一样成为一名工程师。

en: His father designs bridges and buildings, and Tom admires his work.
zh: 他的父亲设计桥梁和建筑，Tom很钦佩他的工作。

en: 'What do you want to be in the future?' Tom often asks himself.
zh: “你将来想做什么？”汤姆经常问自己。

en: Last week, our school had a special guest visit.
zh: 上周，我们学校迎来了一位特别的客人。

en: Johnson, a famous futurist, came to talk about what the future might be like.
zh: 著名未来学家约翰逊前来畅谈未来的可能面貌。

en: 'Will most people live in outer space?' someone asked.
zh: “大多数人会生活在外太空吗？”有人问道。

en: 'What will happen to traditional schools?' I questioned.
zh: “传统学校会怎么样？”我问道。

en: With hard work, I believe dreams can come true.
zh: 我相信，只要肯下苦功，梦想就能成真。

en: A new sci-fi film is coming out.
zh: 一部新的科幻电影即将上映。

en: Last week, I had a big argument with my best friend Lily over a misunderstanding.
zh: 上周，我和我最好的朋友莉莉因为一场误会而大吵了一架。

en: We were both nervous and didn't talk for three days.
zh: 我们俩都很紧张，三天没说话。

en: Finally, I decided to pay attention to my feelings and write her a letter.
zh: 最后，我决定关注自己的感受，给她写了一封信。

en: The next day, Lily called me and said she received my message.
zh: 第二天，莉莉给我打电话说她收到了我的信息。

en: We agreed to meet at the school hall after class.
zh: 我们约定放学后在学校的礼堂见面。

en: When we saw each other face to face, we both felt calm again.
zh: 当我们面对面相见时，我们都再次感到平静。

en: We made up and promised to communicate better in the future.
zh: 我们言归于好，并承诺将来更好地沟通。

en: I have a question.
zh: 我有一个问题。

en: The third brother shot it, but its fall broke their ship.
zh: 三弟开枪射中了它，但它坠落时砸坏了他们的船。

en: I saw my mother paint.
zh: 我看到我妈妈在画画。

en: I decided to give it a go.
zh: 我决定试一试。

en: Last weekend, I went to the sports centre to try ice-skating for the first time.
zh: 上周末，我第一次去滑冰中心尝试滑冰。

en: I was scared of falling, but my friend encouraged me to give it a go.
zh: 我害怕摔倒，但我的朋友鼓励我试一试。

en: After several attempts, I managed to skate a little.
zh: 经过几次尝试，我终于滑了一小段。

en: It was quite an achievement for me!
zh: 对我来说，这相当是一项成就！

en: I ate too much last night.
zh: 我昨晚吃得太多了。

en: Now my stomach aches.
zh: 我肚子痛。

en: You should see the dentist and get an X-ray.
zh: 您应该去看牙医并拍X光片。

en: You could eat some soft food for now.
zh: 你现在可以吃些软食。

en: Be more careful next time.
zh: 下次小心点。

en: Tom, a curious young explorer, had always dreamed of discovering natural wonders.
zh: 汤姆是一位好奇心旺盛的年轻探险家，他一直梦想着探索大自然的奇观。

en: Last summer, he traveled to the northeastern coast to explore the mysterious depths of the ocean.
zh: 去年夏天，他前往东北海岸探索海洋的神秘深处。

en: With his determination, he measured the depth bit by bit using special equipment.
zh: 凭借他的决心，他使用特殊设备一点一点地测量深度。

en: Last Saturday, I was visiting my grandparents in their neighbourhood when a heavy rainstorm suddenly hit.
zh: 上周六，我正在祖父母家所在的街区拜访时，突然遭遇了一场大暴雨。

en: The rain was pouring down so hard that floodwater began to rise quickly on the streets.
zh: 雨下得非常大，洪水很快开始在街道上涨。

en: As soon as I noticed the danger, I called the firefighters for help.
zh: 我一注意到危险，就立即叫了消防员来帮忙。

en: While we were waiting, I saw a schoolgirl struggling in the floodwater near her home.
zh: 在等待期间，我看到一个学校女孩在她家附近的洪水中挣扎。

en: Without hesitation, I jumped in and rescued her just before the water reached her roof.
zh: 我毫不犹豫地跳进去，在水淹到她屋顶前救了她。

en: By the time the firefighters arrived, we were both out of breath but safe.
zh: 等到消防员到达时，我们都上气不接下气，但安全了。

en: Sure.
zh: 当然。

en: Bring a small gift, but don't bring food unless the host asks you to.
zh: 带一份小礼物，但除非房东要求，否则不要带食物。

en: I was surprised by your bow.
zh: 您的鞠躬让我感到惊讶。

en: We usually just say "hello" or shake hands in the US.
zh: 在美国，我们通常只是说“你好”或握手。

en: That's surprising!
zh: 真令人惊讶！

en: In Japan, we bow as soon as we meet a teacher.
zh: 在日本，我们一见到老师就会鞠躬。

en: Last Friday, our class had a special reading activity in the school library.
zh: 上周五，我们班在学校图书馆开展了一次特别的阅读活动。

en: She recommended Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, a famous fantasy novel.
zh: 她推荐了一本著名的奇幻小说《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。

en: 'Have you decided on a book for your report?' she asked with a gentle smile.
zh: “你选好要写报告的书了吗？”她柔和地笑着问道。

en: I nodded and replied, 'Yes, I have.
zh: 我点了点头，回答说：“是的，我有。”

en: The story has a perfect build-up leading to an exciting climax.
zh: 这个故事的铺垫完美无瑕，最终迎来激动人心的高潮。

en: No, I haven’t.
zh: 從未。

en: But one of my friends has volunteered here for a long time.
zh: 不过，我有个朋友在这里当了很长时间的志愿者。

en: Yes, she has.
zh: 是的，她有。

en: She has been a volunteer at a nursing home since last August.
zh: 自去年8月以来，她一直在一家养老院做志愿者。

en: I have been a volunteer at the local animal shelter for three months.
zh: 我在当地动物收容所做志愿者已经三个月了。

en: Every weekend, I help take care of the dogs there.
zh: 每个周末，我都帮忙照顾那里的狗。

en: My grandfather, a Kenyan farmer, has lived in his village for over 60 years.
zh: 我的祖父是一位肯尼亚农民，已经在他的村庄生活了60多年。

en: Twenty years ago, he became good friends with a manager who visited the village for business.
zh: 20年前，他认识了一位来村里做生意的经理，他们成为了好朋友。

en: They haven't seen each other for ages!
zh: 他们已经很多年没有见面了！

en: The manager recently returned and was amazed by the changes.
zh: 最近这位经理回来了，对村庄的变化感到惊讶。

en: The village now has a new hospital, which used to be a small building.
zh: 村里现在有了一家新医院，过去那只是一座小建筑。

en: The government has built a new highway linking the village to the capital.
zh: 政府修建了一条连接村庄和首都的新公路。

en: Digital payment systems have made business transactions convenient.
zh: 电子支付系统使商业交易变得方便。

en: The manager commented that these changes have greatly improved life in the village.
zh: 经理评论说这些变化极大地改善了村庄的生活。

en: Pei was a world-famous British architect who created many amazing buildings around the globe.
zh: 贝聿铭是一位享誉世界的华人建筑师，在全球各地设计了许多令人惊叹的建筑。

en: Pei's work is known for its perfect balance between modern styles and traditional elements.
zh: 贝聿铭的作品以其在现代风格和传统元素之间达成的完美平衡而闻名。

en: One of his most famous projects is the glass pyramid at the Louvre Museum in Paris.
zh: 他最著名的项目之一是巴黎卢浮宫的玻璃金字塔。

en: However, Pei believed that good design could connect different centuries.
zh: 然而，贝聿铭认为，优秀的设计能够将不同的世纪联系起来。

en: Today, millions of visitors admire his creation every year.
zh: 如今，每年都有数百万游客前来欣赏他的作品。

en: Pei once said that architecture should serve mankind and continue to inspire future generations.
zh: 贝聿铭曾说过，建筑应该为人类服务，并继续激励后代。

en: His buildings will live on as testaments to his vision and talent.
zh: 他的建筑将继续存在，见证他的远见和才华。

en: He sometimes fell sick, but he always continued with his work.
zh: 他有时会生病，但他总是坚持工作。

en: Li Hua, a ninth-grade student, was struggling with his English studies recently.
zh: 李华，一名九年级学生，最近在英语学习上遇到了困难。

en: He found it difficult to remember new words and improve his pronunciation.
zh: 他发现很难记住新单词并提高发音。

en: His English teacher suggested that he try some smart learning methods.
zh: 他的英语老师建议他尝试一些智能学习方法。

en: He created flashcards to help him build up his vocabulary step by step.
zh: 他制作了闪卡来逐步增加词汇量。

en: Every evening, he would spend 30 minutes reading English magazines aloud to improve his pronunciation.
zh: 每天晚上，他会花30分钟大声朗读英语杂志以提高发音。

en: His teacher gave him helpful feedback on his progress.
zh: 老师对他的进步给予了有用的反馈。

en: After two months of actively trying these new methods, Li Hua's English skills improved significantly.
zh: 在积极尝试这些新方法两个月后，李华的英语技能显著提高。

en: He believes that finding enjoyable ways to learn is the key to success.
zh: 他认为找到有趣的学习方式是成功的关键。

en: Hi, this is Ella's podcast.
zh: 大家好，这是Ella的播客。

en: Last week, I attended a lecture about memory at the mall.
zh: 上周，我在购物中心参加了一场关于记忆的讲座。

en: The speaker, a grown-up scientist, discussed how our brain works to keep information.
zh: 演讲者是一位成年科学家，讨论了我们大脑如何保存信息。

en: He suggested dividing study materials into smaller parts to make it more effective.
zh: 他建议将学习材料分成小部分，使其更有效。

en: For example, instead of memorizing a long list of words, we can divide them into groups.
zh: 例如，与其记住一长串单词，我们可以将它们分组。

en: This method can boost our long-term memory.
zh: 这种方法可以促进我们的长期记忆。

en: I tried it with my English vocabulary and found it really helpful.
zh: 我将其用于英语词汇，发现真的很有帮助。

en: However, you should not wear out your brain.
zh: 不过，您也不要过度劳神。

en: Last year, he invented a special device that helps people with frozen hands.
zh: 去年，他发明了一种特殊装置，可以帮助手部冻伤的人。

en: His invention gradually gained attention from local companies.
zh: 他的发明逐渐引起了当地企业的关注。

en: One officer even visited his school to see the device in action.
zh: 一位警官甚至前往他的学校，实地观看了该设备的运作情况。

en: Li Hua's creation led to an opportunity to present his idea at a science fair.
zh: 李华的发明让他有机会在科技展上展示自己的创意。

en: If you review what you have learnt, you will acquire new knowledge more effectively.
zh: 如果您复习所学内容，就能更有效地掌握新知识。

en: He developed the idea in the 1890s.
zh: 他在19世纪90年代提出了这个想法。

en: The Qinghai-Xizang Railway was completed in 2006.
zh: 青藏铁路于2006年建成通车。

en: Next, the liquid was poured over a bamboo screen, leaving just the fibre.
zh: 接下来，将液体倒在竹筛上，只留下纤维。

en: It could stick things, but it could be removed very easily.
zh: 它可以粘住东西，但也很容易被取下。

en: There were two main challenges.
zh: 主要有两项挑战。

en: As a young astronaut, I have always been fascinated by Mars.
zh: 作为一名年轻的宇航员，我一直对火星着迷。

en: Last month, I had the chance to join a manned mission to the red planet.
zh: 上个月，我有机会参加一次前往红色星球的载人任务。

en: The spacecraft was crowded with equipment and supplies for our exploration.
zh: 宇宙飞船上挤满了我们探索所需的设备和物资。

en: On board, we worked together to operate the rover and survey the Martian surface.
zh: 在船上，我们合作操作探测器并绘制火星表面图。

en: The geology of Mars is mysterious and full of surprises.
zh: 火星的地质充满神秘和惊喜。

en: Sometimes, I couldn't fall asleep because of the excitement of our mission.
zh: 有时，我因为任务太兴奋而无法入睡。

en: It is believed that our understanding of the universe will be greatly improved through this journey.
zh: 人们相信，通过这次旅程，我们对宇宙的理解将大大提高。

en: Well, there are three good reasons to explore space.
zh: 嗯，探索太空有三个很好的理由。

en: It might take hundreds of thousands of years to get there!
zh: 可能需要数十万年才能到达那里！

en: Last weekend, I attended a music festival in our city.
zh: 上周末，我参加了我们城市的一个音乐节。

en: As a music lover, I was excited to see different performances.
zh: 作为一个音乐爱好者，我很兴奋能观看不同的表演。

en: The first piece I heard was classical music played by a talented pianist.
zh: 我听的第一首曲子是一位有才华的钢琴家演奏的古典音乐。

en: Her fingers moved flowing across the keyboard, creating beautiful sounds.
zh: 她的手指在电子琴上流畅地移动，创造出美妙的旋律。

en: I love traditional music that tells a story, and this piece definitely did that.
zh: 我喜欢讲述故事的传统音乐，这首曲子确实做到了这一点。

en: Later, there was a jazz performance with an electric guitar.
zh: 后来，有一场爵士乐表演，配有电吉他。

en: The performer was so gifted that he could make the guitar sound like it was singing.
zh: 这位演奏者非常有天赋，他能使吉他听起来像在唱歌。

en: The festival showed me how music can bring people together without looking down on any style.
zh: 这个音乐节向我展示了音乐如何将人们聚集在一起，而不轻视任何风格。

en: He didn't attend music school until he was 16, but soon outdid his teachers.
zh: 他直到16岁才上音乐学校，但很快就超过了他的老师。

en: The annual sports meet was approaching, and our class was preparing for the 4 × 100 m relay.
zh: 年度运动会即将到来，我们班正在准备4×100米接力赛。

en: The crowd would cheer loudly when our runners competed against others.
zh: 当我们的选手与其他班级竞争时，人群会大声欢呼。

en: Neither Wang Yaming nor I had expected such a dramatic finish.
zh: 王亚明和我都没有想到会有如此激动人心的结局。

en: When Adam crossed the finish line first, our class erupted with pride.
zh: 当亚当第一个冲过终点线时，我们班爆发出自豪的欢呼声。

en: The baton symbolized more than just a game—it represented our team's harmony and spirit.
zh: 接力棒不仅仅代表一场比赛——它象征着我们团队的和谐与精神。

en: The judges are reviewing the video to decide who the winner is.
zh: 评委们正在观看视频，以决定谁是优胜者。
